# Tests that should pass on the haze backend and do not yet, one `PATTERN | REASON` per line (gtest
# patterns, several joined with `:`). Unlike the not-applicable list, a test here has a meaning on this
# backend: it needs something the backend lacks, and the reason says what. It is left out of the run
# like a not-applicable test, and the test report counts it as a known gap, in a column of its own.
# Remove the line when the gap closes; the test then runs.
#
# A pattern that matches no test is an error (see .github/scripts/run_gtest.py).

Shapes/ApiParityBootstrapShapeTest.EvalBootstrap/Sparse_FIXEDMANUAL:LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FIXEDMANUAL | The bootstrap under FIXEDMANUAL ends one level lower than OpenFHE's, so at the deepest input OpenFHE accepts it gains no level and returns its input
Shapes/ApiParityBootstrapShapeTest.EvalBootstrap/SparseEncapsulated_* | Not implemented: the bootstrap of SPARSE_ENCAPSULATED secrets is refused with an error (HazeBootstrap.RefusesSparseEncapsulatedSecrets tests the refusal)
LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FLEXIBLEAUTO*:LevelBudgets/ApiParityFullPackBootstrapTest.EvalBootstrapFullyPacked/*FLEXIBLEAUTOEXT | The in-process simulator cannot hold a fully packed FLEXIBLE bootstrap at the ring size its replay bridge accepts for FLEXIBLE scaling primes (2^16)
